items: [ 1080P FHD Travel Monitor ] With a 15.6'' 1920*1080 advanced IPS screen, and breathtaking HDR tech, KYY portable travel monitor offers you a 178°wider viewing angle, restores clearer and more vivid pictures, and brings you a smoother immersive visual experience. 1.58 lbs lightweight and 0.3'' ultra-slim frame make it portable for on-the-go. Low blue light eye protection tech avoids your eye fatigue when watching for a long time or when traveling.

[ New Setting Button Design ] KYY K3-2 portable screen adapts a friendly one-to-one button setting design, clearer icon indicator, and more simplicity compared with the trackwheel. Simply press the Plus or Minus button to quickly the brightness and volume of the monitor, no need to enter the OSD menu when you’re watching videos or playing games. Save you more time and bring more convenience.

[ Upgraded 3-in-1 Smart Stand ] Envelope-like design smart cover is like a laptop bag, providing all-around protection. Put on a backpack without any worries, easier to carry on the go. Better than traditional monitor stand, it supports both horizontally and vertically putting. The buckle ensures that the screen will not slip out, two grooves on the cover bottom, and different putting methods give at least some choice of viewing angle for your comfort.

[ USB-C HDMI Compatible Portable Monitor ] Equipped with dual full function Type-C ports and a Mini HDMI port, KYY monitor works well with most laptops, smartphones, PCs, Switch, Xbox, PS4/5, etc. This external display can be connected with only 1 USB C to USB C cable as long as the type-C port on your device supports video output. Plug and play, no needed drivers and apps! Note: Devices without a full-function type-C port or HDMI port need an extra adapter.

[ Multiple Modes For Working Gaming ] KYY USB-C second portable screen can be used as the main screen alone. Or you can share your screen in meeting under duplicated modes or expand your Switch screen when playing games under extended modes. Optional landscape and portrait modes can be adjusted for you to handle different work like editing photos, browsing websites, reading books, and analyzing data to boost your productivity.
